name: Hackett Munster
source:
A knight in Volcano Kingdom who possesses outstanding skills. He grew up on the lakeside of Wild Horse Lake and helped with farm work every and then. He always has a bountiful harvest because of his love for nature and animals.

He used to be an orphan who lived among other refugees, who all helped raise him. He was later adopted by the same woman who adopted Benson.

He likes to go into the forest because it seems he has something big planned. He has an extreme distaste for pocahers.

[Edited from in-game bio]
